selected_evidence.requirement: Primary/standby replication established (node1 primary, node2/node3 standby)
selected_evidence.summary: node1 initialized as primary with wal_level/replica settings and replicator role; node2 and node3 built via pg_basebackup with -R and started as standbys (pg_is_in_recovery=t).

selected_evidence.requirement: Replication actively streaming and data propagating from primary to both standbys
selected_evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both walreceivers streaming; a new row inserted on node1 appears on node2 and node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: Failover: standby takes over as writable primary without losing committed data
selected_evidence.summary: Marker row committed and confirmed replicated to both standbys before node1 was stopped; node2 promoted via pg_promote() and confirmed writable with all 4 pre-failover rows intact plus a new post-failover write.

selected_evidence.requirement: Surviving standby (node3) repointed to new primary (node2)
selected_evidence.summary: node3's primary_conninfo updated to node2 and restarted; node2 shows node3's walreceiver streaming; node3 has full post-failover dataset.

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary (node1) rejoins as standby of the current primary (node2)
selected_evidence.summary: node1 rebuilt via pg_basebackup from node2, started in recovery mode with all data intact; node2 shows both node1 and node3 streaming; a new write on node2 propagates to both.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6bb7e004... captured with active standby and 6 rows; reboot acked before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 12244391... (changed); postgresql active, standby recovered, data intact, node2 shows node1 streaming again.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id fbdf5b2c... captured with active standby and 6 rows; reboot acked before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 318b155b... (changed); postgresql active, standby recovered, data intact, node2 shows both standbys streaming.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state with quorum
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bf4e9cbb... captured as active primary with 6 rows; reboot acked before disconnect; post-restart boot_id cf4a8c23... (changed); postgresql active as primary again, both node1 and node3 walreceivers streaming.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart end-to-end data integrity across full cluster
selected_evidence.summary: New row inserted on node2 (primary) after all three restarts; node1 and node3 both report matching row count of 7, confirming replication fully healthy end-to-end.
